definitions.explanation: A young woman who serves at a Shinto shrine. Traditionally performs ceremonial dances, assists with rituals, and handles shrine administrative tasks. Recognizable by their white top and red hakama.

examples.japanese: {巫女|みこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{舞|まい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奉納|ほうのう}→奉納：12200_hounou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The shrine maiden performs a ceremonial dance.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{巫女|みこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}っている→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: At New Year's, shrine maidens sell protective charms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大学生|だいがくせい}→大学生：01653_daigakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{巫女|みこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When she was a university student, she worked part-time as a shrine maiden at a local shrine.

notes:
USAGE:
{巫女|みこ} serve at Shinto shrines and are recognizable by their traditional outfit of a {白衣|はくい} (white robe top) and {緋袴|ひばかま} (scarlet hakama trousers). Their duties include performing ⟦{神楽|かぐら}→神楽：14078_kagura⟧ (sacred dances), assisting the ⟦{神主|かんぬし}→神主：16732_kannushi⟧ (priest) during rituals, and selling {御守|おまもり} (protective charms) and {御札|おふだ} (talismans). Many modern {巫女|みこ} are part-time workers, especially during busy periods like ⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧ (first shrine visit of the year).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巫女|みこ}⟦{装束|しょうぞく}→装束：14048_shouzoku⟧: shrine maiden outfit
- {巫女|みこ}{舞|まい}: shrine maiden dance
- {巫女|みこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧: part-time shrine maiden work
